title: 22 战凝元23 唯一的出口
content_zh:
洛豪只想了一瞬间就明白了，因为他在中洲只杀了大云刀宫的向阳，而这个高手很有可能与大云刀宫的向阳有关系，应该就是向阳在大云刀宫的背后的势力出手了。
于是洛豪直接选择了不去横断山脉外围了，既然横断山谷有人能进来，那么横断山脉外围一定有高手埋伏着等他，所以洛豪直接调头，准备返回横断山谷。
洛豪是知道的，相对于嗜血飞蚁群来说，大云刀宫的危险才是洛豪不能应对的。
然而还没等洛豪返回进横断山谷，一道强劲的剑光，带着强大的气势，朝洛豪攻来。
剑光到来时，洛豪就已经感应到了，黑蛛刀一挥，一道绚烂的刀虹轰出，迎向了这攻来的剑光。
轰，咔嚓的声音响起，剑光与洛豪的刀虹撞击在一起，洛豪与发出剑光的修士各自倒退了数十步，然后相对而立。
此时洛豪已经看清楚了攻击他的修士，是一个穿着黑色修士服的，脸上有些许坚毅的气色的青年。
洛豪估计他的年龄应该比向阳要大一点，而他的手中的长剑竟然是一把极品攻击灵器，长剑的剑锋十分的凌厉，甚至比洛豪的黑蛛刀还要强势一些。
从他的外相来看，就知道他经历过不少的战斗，这是一个实力强劲的对手，而且洛豪也看出了他的实力境界，竟然只是凝元初期。
“难怪能够杀了我师弟向阳，看来你的真实实力绝对不是表面上的结真初期巅峰，你的隐匿功法十分的强大，连我都看不出来你到底是不是凝元期。“
这个青年表面十分的平静，但内心却是非常的震惊，因为还从来没有人能够仓促之下挡住他的偷袭。
没错，他是趁着洛豪调头的那一瞬间发动了偷袭，速度不可谓不快，就是一般的凝元中期修士也不一定能够挡住他的偷袭。
而洛豪一个小小的结真初期巅峰居然在匆忙之下发动了反击，然后挡住了他的偷袭。
“你是谁？“
洛豪并没有回应青年的话，而是询问这个青年的身份。
虽然洛豪没有明说自己是杀了向阳的凶手，但洛豪知道就算自己否认也没用，大云刀宫一个修真门派，连这么一点消息都调查不出来，那就算不上一个门派了。
“大云刀宫向强，来要你命的人，“
向强说完，再次挥动长剑，数道剑芒爆发出恐怖的力量，把地面都划出了剑坑，径直冲向了洛豪。
洛豪早就暗暗防备着向强的出手，向强发动剑芒的那一瞬间，洛豪就长啸一声，浮沉刀再次出现，一道大约十丈长的刀幕化为了一片刀墙，将向强的剑芒给包围住了，然后刀墙和剑芒发生了剧烈的碰撞。
轰的一声，剑芒和刀墙全部消散，四周烟尘四起，就好像沙尘暴到来了一般，数十秒过后，烟尘才散去。

然后洛豪和向强两人却各自战在了一起，黑蛛刀和向强的长剑撞击在一起发出刺啦的声响。
向强显然是想在剑芒之后发动全力一击让洛豪防不胜防的，但是令他感到意外的是，洛豪居然还能够发动刀幕挡住他的云杀剑芒，并且主动硬接下他的全力一击，向强的脸色开始变得凝重起来。
他的云杀剑芒可是经历过强者的战斗洗礼的，死在他的云杀剑芒下的高手数不胜数，甚至一般的凝元中期修士都不一定能挡得住他的云杀剑芒。
他可是大云刀宫的十大天才之一，却和一个名不见经传的结真初期巅峰修士打的旗鼓相当。
“有种，难怪敢杀了我师弟，要是等你到了成丹期，估计大云刀宫宫主都不一定是你的对手，可惜的是，你今天就到此为止了，死在我向强的手下，你也不算吃亏。“
向强长剑一挥，又是数万道剑气轰向了洛豪，同时向强开口说话想要扰乱洛豪的心神。
“你还没有本事能够杀了我。“
洛豪也不甘示弱，黑蛛刀再次轰出数万道刀气，迎向了向强的剑气。
刀气和剑气互相肆虐，把整个地面都划出了无数的痕迹，到处都是剑气或者刀气划出的沟壑。
数万道刀气和数万道剑气撞击在一起，发出霹雳的声响，甚至摩擦出了剧烈的火花，然后刀气和剑气就好像两个交战的军队一般，气势强大，谁也不让谁通过。
过了足足一分钟，数万道刀气和数万道剑气，才再次消散，而洛豪和向强两人都没有占到便宜。
“云杀剑第一式，云杀剑虹，给我冲。“
向强双手握住长剑，举过头顶，汇聚了全身的真元，注入到长剑中，话音刚落，两道绚烂的剑虹从地面上生起，朝洛豪攻了过来。
这一击可以看出向强已经将洛豪当做同等层次的对手，使出全力了。
云杀剑法一共十八式，但向强只学会了前三式，不过就算是前三式也足以打败一个凝元中期的修士了。
以往碰到的修士当中，只有一个凝元中期的修士才值得向强使用了云杀剑法，而这次洛豪一个结真初期巅峰居然逼得他使用自己的绝杀云杀剑法，向强甚至在想即便云杀剑法可以杀了洛豪，也是毫无成就感。
content_en:
Luo Hao thought for a moment and understood, because he only killed Xiang Yang of Dayun Blade Palace in Zhongzhou, and this master was probably related to Xiang Yang of Dayun Blade Palace. It should be Xiang Yang's force behind Dayun Blade Palace.
So Luo Hao directly chose not to go to the outskirts of the Hengduan Mountains. Since someone could come in from the Hengduan Mountains, there must be experts waiting for him outside the Hengduan Mountains, so Luo Hao turned around and prepared to return to the Hengduan Valley.
Luo Hao knew that compared to the bloodthirsty flying ants, the danger of Dayun Dao Palace was something Luo Hao could not deal with.
However, before Luo Hao could return to the Hengduan Valley, a strong sword light attacked Luo Hao with a powerful momentum.
When the sword light arrived, Luo Hao had already sensed it. With a wave of the black spider sword, a brilliant sword rainbow blasted out to meet the incoming sword light.
Boom, there was a clicking sound, and the sword light collided with Luo Hao's sword rainbow. Luo Hao and the monk who issued the sword light each stepped back dozens of steps, and then stood opposite each other.
At this time, Luo Hao had clearly seen the monk who attacked him. He was a young man wearing a black monk's uniform with a somewhat resolute look on his face.
Luo Hao estimated that he should be a little older than Xiang Yang, and the long sword in his hand turned out to be a top-notch offensive weapon. The blade of the long sword was very sharp, even stronger than Luo Hao's Black Spider Sword.
Judging from his appearance, we can tell that he has experienced many battles. This is a strong opponent, and Luo Hao can also see that his level of strength is only in the early stage of Yuan Condensation.
"No wonder you were able to kill my junior brother Xiang Yang. It seems that your true strength is definitely not the peak of the early stage of Jie Zhen on the surface. Your concealment technique is very powerful. Even I can't tell whether you are at the Ning Yuan stage."
This young man looked very calm on the surface, but he was very shocked inside because no one had ever been able to block his sneak attack in a hurry.
That's right, he took advantage of the moment Luo Hao turned around to launch a sneak attack. The speed was not bad, and even an ordinary mid-level Condensing Yuan monk might not be able to block his sneak attack.
However, Luo Hao, who was at his peak in the early stages of his conscientiousness, actually launched a counterattack in a hurry, and then blocked his sneak attack.
"Who are you?"
Luo Hao did not respond to the young man's words, but asked the young man's identity.
Although Luo Hao did not explicitly say that he was the murderer of Xiang Yang, Luo Hao knew that even if he denied it, it would be useless. If a cultivation sect in Dayun Dao Palace could not even investigate such a little information, it would not be considered a sect.
"Dayun Dao Palace Xiang Qiang, the person who comes to kill you,"
After Xiang Qiang finished speaking, he swung his sword again, and several rays of sword light erupted with terrifying power, creating sword pits on the ground and rushing straight towards Luo Hao.
Luo Hao had long been secretly guarding against Xiang Qiang's attack. The moment Xiang Qiang activated his sword light, Luo Hao roared loudly, and the floating sword appeared again. A sword curtain about ten feet long turned into a sword wall, surrounding Xiang Qiang's sword light. Then the sword wall and the sword light collided violently.
With a bang, the sword light and the sword wall all dissipated, and smoke and dust spread all around, as if a sandstorm had arrived. After dozens of seconds, the smoke and dust dispersed.
Then Luo Hao and Xiang Qiang fought each other, and the black spider knife and Xiang Qiang's long sword collided together, making a stabbing sound.
Xiang Qiang obviously wanted to launch a full-strength blow after the sword light to make Luo Hao unprepared, but to his surprise, Luo Hao was able to activate the sword screen to block his cloud-killing sword light, and took the initiative to take his full-strength blow. Xiang Qiang's face began to become solemn.
His Cloud Killing Sword Light has experienced the baptism of battles by strong men. Countless masters have died under his Cloud Killing Sword Light. Even ordinary monks in the middle stage of Condensation Yuan may not be able to block his Cloud Killing Sword Light.
He is one of the top ten geniuses in the Great Cloud Sword Palace, but he has an affair with an unknown person.The peak monks in the early stage of Jie Zhen were evenly matched.
"If you have the guts, no wonder you dare to kill my junior brother. If you wait until you reach the stage of becoming a pill, I guess the master of Dayun Dao Palace may not be your opponent. It's a pity that this is the end of the day for you. If you die at the hands of me, Xiang Qiang, you will not suffer a loss."
Xiang Qiang waved his long sword, and tens of thousands of sword energy blasted towards Luo Hao. At the same time, Xiang Qiang spoke to disturb Luo Hao's mind.
"You are not capable of killing me yet."
Not to be outdone, Luo Hao fired out tens of thousands of sword energy from the Black Spider Sword again, facing Xiang Qiang's sword energy.
The sword energy and the sword energy raged against each other, leaving countless marks on the entire ground. There were ravines created by the sword energy or sword energy everywhere.
Tens of thousands of sword qi and tens of thousands of sword qi collided together, making a thunderous sound, and even causing violent sparks. Then the sword qi and sword qi were like two warring armies. They were so powerful that no one was allowed to pass.
It took a full minute for tens of thousands of sword energy and tens of thousands of sword energy to dissipate again, but neither Luo Hao nor Xiang Qiang took advantage.
"The first move of Yun Sha Sword, Yun Sha Jian Hong, charge for me."
Xiang Qiang held the long sword with both hands, raised it above his head, gathered all the true energy in his body, and poured it into the long sword. As soon as he finished speaking, two gorgeous sword rainbows rose from the ground and attacked Luo Hao.
This blow showed that Xiang Qiang had regarded Luo Hao as an opponent of the same level and used all his strength.
There are a total of eighteen moves in Yunsha Sword Technique, but Xiang Qiang only learned the first three moves, but even the first three moves are enough to defeat a monk in the middle stage of Yuan Condensation.
Among the monks he met in the past, only a monk in the middle stage of Yuan Condensation was worthy of Xiang Qiang's use of the Cloud Killing Sword Technique. But this time, Luo Hao, who was at the peak of his early stage of perfection, actually forced him to use his own killer Cloud Killing Sword Technique. Xiang Qiang even thought that even if the Cloud Killing Sword Technique could kill Luo Hao, there would be no sense of achievement.
